ClassInsight.//RoomName: Optional. Join only the classroom server with this room name, for networks that host several rooms. Empty = join the first server found.
ClassInsight.//ServerAddress: Optional host or host:port of the server, tried when UDP broadcast discovery finds nothing (networks that block broadcast).
ClassInsight.//ReportBrowserActivity: Report the host (domain only, never the full URL) of the foreground browser tab.
